speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: There thou art. The loaf is cut, and the children have counted thee twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am the second count. The first was a charitable rumour.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thou wert a rumour till the moon left the wall. Sit. Church is not a rumour.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: May I take Golding after dinner? I am at the wall, and I want the daylight on it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After church, and after the Sadlers. The light will keep.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The river will keep too, if we are quick. Judith has named her boat and she will not tell me the name.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: A name told before the water is a name that sinks.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Three of them, brother, and none of them washed for a boat. Church first. I have said it to each, and I am not a bell.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Eat. You will have the middle of the loaf. Do not argue a crust into a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The middle is an honest cut. I will not improve it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Susanna may take the book when dinner is done. Thou wilt have the three of them home before I want the path. Joan keeps them after that.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: I keep them when thou art gone toward Shottery, and not before. I have beans. I will not have beans and a river in the same hour.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Then the river is between dinner and the beans.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Toward the middle of the afternoon. Not the whole of it. Thou hast heard me.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I heard you. I am bringing the book, not a complaint.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: If the book comes, the boats come. That is the rule.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: That is not a rule. That is thee wanting both.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Do not make a law of a jug. Church, the pack of you.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The book stays on the shelf until dinner is eaten. I will not have it in the pew.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I was not going to take it to church.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. The pew has enough of me without a book. And the stone is back on the sheet. I looked, and I did not sit.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Wash, all three. I am not sending yesterday's hands to the parish, and I am not sending river-hands either. The river is later.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: My hands are clean.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: They are clean of washing. They are not clean of the idea of a boat.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Out, the pair of you. Susanna, the book on the shelf until I say.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: On the shelf. I can wait a dinner.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: And you can sit, son, until the bread has found you. The bell will do the rest.
